scope: Minimal compatibility conclusions relevant to content changes; no private source or documents are included.

findings.spawn2Timers: Respawn and variance values use seconds. This is a compatibility conclusion, not live verification.
findings.groundTimers: Ground-item respawn values use seconds. Imported fast values are not assumed to be intentional adaptations.
findings.questDamage: The reviewed runtime cannot apply the required damaging player explosion through the legacy quest path. A safe content-only substitute has not been established.
findings.containers: Registration and recipe-policy dependencies remain downstream. See runtime-container-evidence.json and container-compatibility.json.

limits: These compatibility findings do not substitute for independent current runtime review or live gameplay testing.
Public baseline references remain valid for the exported snapshot only.
Changing a private runtime requires separate authorization.
